criteria.description: Required: the requested solid background is visually uniform, texture-free, and clearly separated from the illustration.
Required: object contours are continuous and visually closed; outline hues match their local objects rather than using one generic black contour.
Required: intentional light object regions are visibly distinct from the solid background and remain enclosed by their object contours.
Required: no painted aura, halo, diffuse shadow, or watercolor fade weakens the contrast between the subject edge and solid background.
Required: coral content, pastel watercolor medium, delicate linework, decorative density, and playful marine character are recognizably similar to the uploaded reference.
